name: Important Heirlooms

angles.text: As a gnome, Thom's clumsy cover story shows how curiosity can turn toward valuable relics.
As a dwarf, you may doubt Thom's sudden interest in ancestral relics when he keeps slipping into talk of loot and appraisal.
As a rogue, you can see through Thom's claim that he was patrolling the vaults. He is a scavenger caught off guard by an underground invasion.

faq.answer: Thom is a nervous gnome near the vaults who asks for help retrieving relics. His slips about loot and appraisal suggest he cares more for plunder than vault security.
The Hall of Thanes is an underground dwarven vault holding ancient cultural relics and heirlooms. Dark Iron forces have breached it.
faq.q: What is the Hall of Thanes?

faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves tunneled into the vaults from below in mole machines. Their purpose is unknown.
faq.q: Why are Dark Iron dwarves in the vaults?

faq.answer: Thom says he will return the relics to places of honor, but his words raise doubts. He calls lurking patrol and cataloguing appraisal, and speaks of loot and a haul.
faq.q: Is Thom really returning the heirlooms?

faq.answer: The Dwarven Heirlooms are ancient cultural relics kept in the Hall of Thanes. Historians prize them, while opportunists such as Thom see valuable loot.
Dark Iron mole machines caught Thom off guard while he was lurking in the vaults. He cannot safely gather the relics without an adventurer's protection.
faq.q: Why can't Thom retrieve the heirlooms himself?

sections.body: Thom is a gnome caught in the Hall of Thanes when Dark Iron dwarves tunnel up in mole machines. He cannot secure the vaults alone, so he asks passing adventurers to enter the hostile dig site. The dwarven relics lie scattered through the chambers. The invaders may seize or destroy them.
sections.title: Trouble in the Vaults

sections.body: Thom says he was patrolling and wants to catalogue the relics for preservation. Yet he lets slip talk of priceless loot and appraising the haul. He pays you well to face the danger, but whether the treasures will reach a museum or an auction block remains unclear.
sections.title: Cultural Preservation or Lucrative Plunder?

summary: In the Hall of Thanes, Dark Iron dwarves break into the vaults while Thom is caught inside. The nervous gnome asks you to gather the scattered dwarven relics before the invaders reach them.
